_comment: AI-DLC framework-default model rate table, USD per 1,000,000 tokens. These are PUBLIC Anthropic list prices (platform.claude.com/docs pricing) as of 2026-07, shipped as defaults ONLY. To override, set AIDLC_MODEL_RATES to a rates file of the same shape, or drop a model-rates.json into your install's tools/data/ dir. Keys are generation-discrete (one row per model generation, never family-collapsed) so a new generation is priced correctly rather than mis-priced onto an old row. input/output price ordinary prompt/completion tokens; cacheWrite5m/cacheWrite1h price cache CREATION at the two ephemeral TTLs (standard multipliers: 1.25x input for 5m, 2x input for 1h); cacheRead prices a cache HIT (0.1x input). An unknown model is recorded with tokens but a null cost - never mis-priced.
